# Temporal Measurement

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:TemporalMeasurement`](gmeow-TemporalMeasurement.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/TemporalMeasurement>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)

A measured assignment of a date or age to an entity or sample, carrying the method, uncertainty, and determinacy. Now a subclass of [`gmeow:Measurement`](gmeow-Measurement.md) (and therefore [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md)), realising [Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9): the measurement is a standpoint-indexed claim (vantage + [`observedFeature`](../properties/gmeow-observedFeature.md) + [`observationResult`](../properties/gmeow-observationResult.md)), not ground truth.
